Class AetherisNotebookPanel.QuietCaret

All Implemented Interfaces:

Enclosing class:
AetherisNotebookPanel
private static final class AetherisNotebookPanel.QuietCaret extends DefaultCaret
The class QuietCaret is a caret that does not select text. The update policy is NEVER_UPDATE, so a document change does not scroll to the caret. A mouse press, drag, click, or release is ignored. setSelectionVisible(boolean) always hides the selection. moveDot(int, javax.swing.text.Position.Bias) moves the dot and does not keep a range. adjustVisibility(Rectangle) does not scroll.
